mapper.select: SELECT po.po_id, po.po_number, po.vendor_id, po.status, po.order_date, po.expected_date, po.created_at, po.created_by, po.updated_at, po.updated_by, v.vendor_code, v.name AS vendor_name, v.active AS vendor_active, pol.po_line_id, pol.po_id AS line_po_id, pol.line_number, pol.product_id, pol.quantity_ordered, pol.quantity_received, pol.unit_cost, p.sku, p.description AS product_description FROM purchase_order po JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = po.vendor_id LEFT JOIN purchase_order_line pol ON pol.po_id = po.po_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pol.product_id WHERE po.po_id = #{poId} ORDER BY pol.line_number

SELECT pol.po_line_id, pol.po_id, pol.line_number, pol.product_id, pol.quantity_ordered, pol.quantity_received, pol.unit_cost, p.sku, p.description AS product_description FROM purchase_order_line pol JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pol.product_id WHERE pol.po_line_id = #{poLineId}
SELECT po_id FROM purchase_order WHERE po_id = #{poId} FOR UPDATE
